title: Faceland RPG
description: Faceland is a Minecraft MMO like no other! It has things, stuff, and more! Wow! Connect at play.face.land!
body:
# Faceland RPG

**Faceland RPG** is a Minecraft MMO like not other! Boasting hundreds of hours of adventuring, a classess leveling system, and an impressive collection of powerful and interesting items, you'll never run out of things to stab or shoot or incinerate! If the listed Modrinth IP doesn't work for you, connect with **play.face.land**

## Cool Quests
Faceland features many quests witrh a world full of... very interesting characters! Go on grade adventures and do chores for weirdos!

## Unique Items
Faceland's item system features both randomly generated loot and predesigned unique items with anything from unusual stats to totally game-changing effects! No two builds end up being alike!

## Classless Characters And Abilities
With over 200 abilities that aren't locked by class, but rather equipment (if even that!) you can mix and match your moves to suit your build and playstyle.

## Professions
We got em, and they're more rewarding than ever, somehow grindier than ever, but also totally optional if that's not your thing. Craft powerful items that can compete with or even exceed the best drops. Enchant items to unlock the full potential! Fish using the custom minigame or the afk fishing system... Or do none of that!

---

**The world of Faceland awaits your arrival!**
